blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Rep. Joel Chua has disputed Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson’s claims that the prosecution panel for the impeachment trial was not scolded by the court for suddenly withdrawing three of four impeachment articles, noting that their decision comes with consequences. Chua said in a press briefing on Wednesday at the Batasang Pambansa complex that contrary to statements from Duterte spokesperson Atty. Paolo Panelo, the prosecution received some tongue-lashing from Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Francis Escudero.
